scope: Concurrency, lock order, generation changes, Retry-After, cache and transfer/session lease

resolvedFindings.issue: Old cover result could apply after a catalog replacement
resolvedFindings.resolution: StationCoverQueue generation, serialized callback publication and invalidate before publishCatalog; stale completion returns CANCELLED without path.

resolvedFindings.issue: 429 could churn through all offscreen entries while the Java store was globally blocked
resolvedFindings.resolution: CoverBackoff pauses speculative plan until Retry-After; only bounded visible priorities may request locally cached images.

verifiedProperties: Four IO workers; same item deduplicated and same cache key serialized; different cover keys can download in parallel.
Coordinator cover closes session lease before invalidate takes the Coordinator monitor, avoiding the detected potential lock inversion.
Artifact authorization, local scan and GET headers hold one session lease; streaming body does not rotate the session before consuming the grant.
Native State changes stay on SDL thread; JNI events use Inbox mutex and atomic publication.
Persistent cache image reads are validated and network is skipped for valid same-revision cached files.
Cancellation is not classified as permanent missing cover; resume can retry.
Retry map4096 matches this branch actual Java/JNI maximum4096; apply clears it. The proposed4097th overflow is not reachable in this branch.
futureCapacityRequirement: If max catalog is raised to40000, enlarge/test CoverRetry and JNI inbox bounds with Java catalog limit in the same change. This review does not assert40000 support.
runtime: No phone use or network traffic by this independent review; parent remains responsible for installed-device checks.
